newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank reverse repo drains 13.5 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank reverse repo drains 13.5 bln SKR.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it drained 13.5 billion crowns from the market in its weekly reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent and will run from February 12 to February 19, replacing an operation that drained 11 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 3.50 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
